name: pixeltable-museum-loans
description: Museum object loan tracker API with overdue flags and urgency bands, explorable from the pxt CLI and dashboard · built with Pixeltable

paragraphs: Track which collection objects are out on loan, to whom, and for how long. Objects carry an accession number, medium, year and gallery; loans record the borrower, venue, status and days out. Pixeltable computes a readable loan label, an overdue flag and an urgency band, and everything is browsable without writing code: the local Pixeltable dashboard and the pxt CLI (ls, describe, rows, get, count, computed) show tables, computed columns and rows directly.
Pixeltable is open-source, Python-native multimodal AI data infrastructure: tables, incremental computed columns, UDFs, indexes and serving in one library, running locally or on Pixeltable Cloud.
